items.title: Return completed claim questionnaire and game-damage certificate
items.quote: Senden Sie uns das ausgefüllte Formular bitte binnen 13 Werktagen nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens zurück (Werktage: Montag bis Samstag ohne gesetzliche Feiertage).
items.computation: This is a private deadline set by the insurer, counted from the letter's own date under §§ 187, 188 BGB. The letter is dated Sat 21.11.2026; as the triggering event, that day itself is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB). The letter defines 'Werktage' as Monday–Saturday excluding statutory public holidays, matching the standard definition. Counting forward only Mon–Sat days from 22.11.2026: Mon 23.11=1, Tue 24.11=2, Wed 25.11=3, Thu 26.11=4, Fri 27.11=5, Sat 28.11=6, Mon 30.11=7, Tue 01.12=8, Wed 02.12=9, Thu 03.12=10, Fri 04.12=11, Sat 05.12=12, Mon 07.12=13. No NRW or nationwide public holidays fall in this window (22.11.–07.12.2026), so none are skipped. The 13th Werktag is Monday 07.12.2026, which is itself a normal working day, so no weekend/holiday shift of the final day is needed.
